excluded_groups_explanation.unselected: No unselected annual or fixed-day NPZ is required to choose the final strategy again. Keep all candidate summary.json inventories, protocol/provenance, named failures and explicit stop records. Excluded partial results remain only local and may not be presented as completed results.

rebuild_scope.new_clone_path_note: Rebuild payload in the new checkout before a script that reads archive.path from the committed payload: current payload records absolute local provenance. Rebuilding references preserves the same arrays and workbook values.
rebuild_scope.templates_and_exp005: Prefer pinned immutable Git objects, with explicit SHA-verified frozen snapshots only if the commit is unavailable. No local main or exp005 side-branch ref is required.
rebuild_scope.fonts_and_runtime: Python environment must include the declared numerical/plotting packages. Existing figure authoring uses a macOS Chinese font; other OS users must choose an installed CJK font for re-rendering. XLSX re-export uses bundled ArtifactTool, while delivered XLSX/compact audit do not require that runtime to read.
